data.name: Kanubhai
data.gender_notes: Kanubhai is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kanu’ meaning ‘Lord’ and ‘Bhai’ meaning ‘Brother’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Kanu is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the protector and sustainer of the universe. The name Kanubhai carries the meaning “Lord Kanu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanubhai usually hope their child will grow to embody lord kanu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection and brotherly love.
data.etymology: Kanubhai belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Kanu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanubhai total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It symbolizes the connection between the individual and the divine and serves as a constant reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and transformation in one's life.
